metadata.title: Hattee gets a place in ST list after half a century wait | जनजाति के लिए आधी सदी का इंतज़ार
metadata.description: The Hattee community had been demanding the ST status since 1967. After a wail of more than 50 years, now prime minister narendra modi led government has fulfilled their demand. Union cabinet has approved a proposal to include Hattee tribe of Himachal Pradesh in the list of scheduled tribes.
